policy: No separate exploratory screen: the certified run is the only search.

supervision: Production domain, stated exactly: the pinned lane Python worker (driver, generator or controls), the pinned encoder-B Python child, and cadical/kissat/drat-trim. The supervisor's scope is the command's process group only; members keep it across re-parenting; a process leaving the group is detected while still a child of a live member, is never signalled, and quarantines capacity.

Strict probes every 0.25 s: alive needs full BSD and task reads with RSS > 0; zombie needs BSD status SZOMB; gone needs ESRCH; anything else is unknown and trips as uncertain. A failed RSS read is never evidence of death.
Trips: RSS > cap, free < floor, elapsed > wall, external SIGTERM/SIGINT, member alive after leader exit, and uncertainty (unknown probe, failed listing, leader gone while unreaped, escape).

Fail-closed exception path: any exception after the command starts records an uncertain UNKNOWN, SIGTERMs the still reserved group, waits a bounded time and quarantines; if measurement fails during the stop, one killpg, a bounded unmeasured wait, survivors unknown (quarantine); the record is always attempted (fallback RECORD.failure.json) and signal handlers are restored in finally.
Stop: killpg(group, SIGTERM) only while the leader is unreaped (its zombie reserves the group ID); bounded 30 s wait; no SIGKILL; no subprocess timeout.
Completion: a final synchronous check of members, RSS, floor and wall before reaping the leader.
Workers refuse to run unless they are the session/group leader under the supervisor file and SHA pinned in this frozen delta (K3_SUPERVISOR_PID, K3_SUPERVISOR_SCRIPT, getsid/getpgrp).
guards_inside_driver: Fresh gate >= 12.2e9 + 10 MiB before preparation and again before the native pipeline; below gate: UNKNOWN receipt, no native stage.
proof_stream.watch: 15-minute checkpoints, keepalive writer, RSS/floor/wall/checker-before-writer stops; proof_stream.stop_children survivors raise and leave the stop to the supervisor.
No CNF or proof file: strengthened bytes fed from memory into two FIFOs with per-feed SHA and byte counts; binary DRAT solver -> FIFO -> drat-trim stdin.
acceptance_predicate: VERIFIED_UNSAT_CASE iff solver rc 20, checker rc 0, checker status lines exactly [b"s VERIFIED"] and solver status lines exactly [b"s UNSATISFIABLE"] (bytes; remove only b"\r"; split on b"\n"; no stripping), no safety stop, no children alive after stop, both measured feeds equal the precomputed strengthened SHA and length (equal to the controls receipt value), no feed thread alive, and solver/checker binaries equal their pins; AND the supervisor record of that run says completed_cleanly true with no trip and no quarantine. SAT_PATTERN_ONLY iff solver rc 10 (Boolean pattern only); all else UNKNOWN, never relabelled.
